purpose: Document official city-specific registry evidence, bounded anonymous geometry review and remaining coverage/runtime limits.
assessment: Beijing’s official service map lists the Fangshan District Real Estate Registration Center and says district centers perform local real-property registration. Beijing Municipal Commission of Planning and Natural Resources policy provides a public online cadastral-map/land-parcel query by parcel identifier, unit number or location. It describes returned parcel metadata and attached drawings, but no machine-readable full polygon schema was established here.
